steps.hardClue: Feed the three flaming stone statues.
steps.clue: Feed the three stone dragons to obtain the Wrath of the Ancients.

steps.hardClue: Upgrade the base weapon into four elemental variants.
steps.clue: Complete the elemental upgrades for the Wrath of the Ancients.

steps.hardClue: Shoot four wisps around the map before time runs out.
steps.clue: Shoot four wisps with an upgraded bow before time runs out.

steps.hardClue: Travel to the past for the soul canister, fuses and safe code.
steps.clue: Travel to the past for the soul canister, fuses and safe code.

steps.hardClue: Open the safe, install the two fuses, then complete both memory games.
steps.clue: Open the safe, install the Tesla fuses, then complete both memory games.

steps.hardClue: Bring down the capsule with the electrical trap, then collect the device.
steps.clue: Use the Death Ray to bring down Dempsey’s capsule, then collect the Vril Device.

steps.hardClue: Shoot the wisps a second time and return to the past for the stone tablet.
steps.clue: Shoot the wisps a second time and return to the past for the stone tablet.

steps.hardClue: Fill the tablet with souls at four locations, then insert the canister into the ancient device.
steps.clue: Fill the Keeper’s tablet with souls at four locations, then insert the Soul Canister into the MPD.

steps.hardClue: Place the specialist weapons on the pressure plates around the device.
steps.clue: Place the Ragnarok DG-4s on the pressure plates around the MPD to enter the boss fight.

steps.hardClue: Defeat the boss, then use the artifact at the control terminal.
steps.clue: Defeat the Keeper, then use the Summoning Key to launch the rockets and destroy the Moon.
